name: kb-library-team
description: A single chief knowledge officer with six internalized domains - ingest, classify, promote, index, grounded Q&A, archive - turning scattered files into a query-ready knowledge base.

displayDescription.zh: 一名首席知识管理官,内化采集、分类、晋级、索引、问答、归档六域职能,把散落资料整理成随问随答的知识库。
displayDescription.en: One chief knowledge officer with six internalized domains turning scattered files into a query-ready knowledge base.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我把这个知识库做一次全面体检,找出分类混乱、死链和过期内容,给出整改清单。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Run a full checkup on my knowledge base: find messy categories, dead links and stale content, then give me a fix list.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我把这个知识库做一次全面体检,找出分类混乱、死链和过期内容,给出整改清单。
quickPrompts.en: Run a full checkup on my knowledge base: find messy categories, dead links and stale content, then give me a fix list.

quickPrompts.zh: 这批新资料帮我登记入库:先出归类清单,我确认后再放进知识库。
quickPrompts.en: Register this batch of new material: give me a classification list first, then file it after my confirmation.
